deviceSend.stageRelay: Direct link blocked, sending through the relay…
deviceSend.mapBlocked: A filament is mapped to a {{noun}} it can’t print on
deviceSend.busy: The printer is busy, so this can only be uploaded for now.
deviceSend.mismatch: This file was sliced for {{sliced}}, but {{name}} is set up as {{preset}}. Choose that printer in the slicer and slice again before printing.
deviceSend.plainGcode: Plain G-code prints filament 1 from the first {{noun}}, filament 2 from the second, and so on. Slice for this printer to send a .gcode.3mf and choose them here.
deviceSend.cantAlert: This device can’t show alerts. The Alerts card on the Device tab says why.
deviceSend.alertsOff: Alerts are off for this printer. A layer here turns them on, with the usual alerts (problems and Finished).
